title: IEANTN (Terence Tao): Explicit Zero-Free Regions of ζ(s) (Rosser–Schoenfeld → Kadiri → MTY)
description: Six verbatim open explicit zero-free region theorems from Terence Tao's IEANTN (teorth/IEANTN@cd9c2dd3, Apache-2.0): Rosser–Schoenfeld (1975) classical & general zero-free regions, Kadiri (2005) improved constant R = 5.69693 conditional on Rosser–Schoenfeld & Wedeniwski's RH height, and Mossinghoff–Trudgian–Yang (2024) classical, intermediate, and Korobov–Vinogradov zero-free regions. Every frozen definition file is SHA-256 identical to upstream.

tasks.title: Rosser–Schoenfeld (1975): explicit zero-free region of ζ(s)
tasks.description: Prove `RosserSchoenfeld.v1.challenge_zero_free_region`: explicit zero-free region of the Riemann zeta function.

tasks.title: Rosser–Schoenfeld (1975): classical zero-free region constant R = 9.645908801
tasks.description: Prove `RosserSchoenfeld.v1.challenge_zero_free_region_classical`: classical de la Vallée Poussin zero-free region with Rosser–Schoenfeld constant.

tasks.title: Kadiri (2005): improved zero-free region R = 5.69693 above height 2
Mossinghoff–Trudgian–Yang (2024): state-of-the-art classical zero-free region
tasks.description: Prove `MTY.v1.challenge_classical_zero_free_region`: explicit classical zero-free region of ζ(s) with Mossinghoff–Trudgian–Yang constant.

tasks.title: Mossinghoff–Trudgian–Yang (2024): intermediate zero-free region
tasks.description: Prove `MTY.v1.challenge_intermediate_zero_free_region`: explicit intermediate-height zero-free region of ζ(s).

tasks.title: Mossinghoff–Trudgian–Yang (2024): explicit Korobov–Vinogradov zero-free region
tasks.description: Prove `MTY.v1.challenge_korobov_vinogradov_region`: explicit Korobov–Vinogradov zero-free region of ζ(s).
